base_case.market_move: EURUSD stays below the 1.1199 release level and falls through the 9 Nov low 1.11465 toward lower levels before 13 Nov 08:00Z, as the hot print widens the US-euro front-end gap.

scenario_analysis.confirmations: (1) BLS core CPI +0.3% m/m against 0.2% consensus; (2) the captured break of 1.1199 in the release second with every USD pair USD-up; (3) the US-euro 2-year gap of 4.51% against 2.96% (dated 5-6 Nov).
scenario_analysis.driver: USD leg, CLEAR in sign (6 Nov -0.79% with USDJPY +0.64%; today with every USD pair); the 9 Nov +0.68% was EUR-specific (USDJPY -0.19%); the rates link is weak (-0.16 over 20 days, -0.25 over 60).
scenario_analysis.invalidation_reason: 1.12180 sits above the 1.12161 H1 flag base (06:52Z ledger) and 1.1199, below the 9 Nov D1 high 1.12250; a trade there means EUR-specific buying has reclaimed the pre-release flag.
scenario_analysis.invalidation_text: any trade above 1.12180; the thesis is also broken by an M15 close above 1.12161 while USDJPY falls below 158.20, a new hawkish ECB signal beyond Nagel's 14:54Z remarks, or the US 2y giving back most of its CPI rise.

main_alternative.market_move: EUR-specific demand and covering of crowded EUR shorts lift EURUSD back above 1.1218, as on 9 Nov when the whole 6 Nov USD move reversed in one session.

scenario_analysis.mechanism: the USD leg; EURUSD's 20-day beta to DXY is -1.09 with correlation -0.97 (Primary's figure, not re-verified by the Critical), the purest USD expression in the set; captured 1.12223 (9 Nov close) to 1.11813 at 15:05:01Z, -0.37% or -0.71 ATR (ATR 0.00581); the 2-year gap was US2Y 4.51% (6 Nov) against EA2Y 2.96% (5 Nov) before today's US rise (context).
scenario_analysis.opposite_mechanism: EUR-specific demand plus covering of an 18%-of-OI EUR short (the 9 Nov pattern) and hawkish-leaning ECB remarks (Nagel 14:54Z, context).
scenario_analysis.positioning: EUR speculators net short 157,791 of 876,122 (18%, COT 3 Nov), covering risk above 1.1216-1.1225; late 9 Nov EUR longs were flushed below 1.1199 at 13:30:01Z. Crowd trade: short EUR, wrong on a repeat of 6-9 Nov, when the whole NFP USD move was retraced the next session.
scenario_analysis.priced: prior_pricing AMBIGUOUS, with the set's largest one-day vol-normalised move (2.18, the 9 Nov +0.67%); 5-day +0.26 ATR (3 Nov close 1.12070 to 9 Nov 1.12223); the capture sits -0.21 ATR under the 20-day mean 1.11934, -1.69 under the 50-day 1.12796 and -5.53 under the 200-day 1.15026; 20-day range 1.11044-1.12731, capture mid-range; T0, the 48 h to 15 min drift and the implied move are not observed.
scenario_analysis.why_no_open: the capture 1.11813 sits 7-13 pips under the reviewed selling zone and only 35 pips above the 9 Nov low, leaving too little room before the 1.11309-1.11499 base.
scenario_analysis.zone_reason: 1.11880-1.11940 retests the broken 6 Nov Asia floor 1.1187-1.1191 and the 29 Oct D1 high 1.11922, under the 1.1199 release level.
